C-PRIVATE-OPERATIONS.Name: Keep operational records and captured user profiles outside public source
C-PRIVATE-OPERATIONS.Summary: Separate private App Store submission records and promotion planning from the public product repository, and retain only sanitized historical preference examples in public fixtures.
C-PRIVATE-OPERATIONS.Problem: Public source includes operational submission state, internal launch planning and captured legacy user profiles that are not required by the current application or its tests.

Goals.Goal: Preserve published versions and current local edits in the private companion before removing public copies of the C-59 operational bundle and promotion planning.
Replace actual host paths in retained preference examples with a synthetic fixture identity; remove captured browser profiles and incidental runtime records; regenerate fixture hashes.
Remove the subsequently republished session backlog and table-copy previews after preserving those exact public versions privately.
Document the public/private boundary and add focused verification that prevents accidental reintroduction of these records.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve unrelated working changes and reusable release tooling; make no App Store API writes.
Leave frozen docs/*.xml and docs/migrations provenance byte-for-byte unchanged.

No runtime behavior change, remote history rewrite, release retagging or credential rotation. The owner subsequently authorized ordinary public main cleanup in this session; release publication remains outside scope.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Removing technical GRACE contracts, current application source, required tests or public release tooling.
Repeating the independently completed secret-scanning enablement or legacy-branch retirement.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Private backups match their sources by SHA-256, including current uncommitted operational edits.
The candidate public tree excludes the operational bundle, promotion planning, captured profile archives and browser runtime records.
Retained examples contain only synthetic home paths and have an exact hash/size manifest; focused checks and GRACE lint pass.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Private backup receipts, fixture hashes, a clean publication boundary check, and unchanged frozen provenance hashes.

Approval.Scope: Explicit instruction to privatize the App Store Connect records and promotion strategy, and replace real computer paths in fixtures, following the publication audit proposal.
Approval.PublicationAuthorization: Owner explicitly instructed public cleanup after reviewing the local commit; this also carries forward the earlier instruction to keep backlog and table-copy previews private. Ordinary main publication only; no history rewriting or release.
